description:
*I am a dedicated Career Counselor with a strong focus on JEE, CET, and NEET aspirants. My mission is to guide students toward the right career path based on their aptitude, interest, and academic strengths, not just marks.*

*With in-depth knowledge of engineering and medical entrance exams, I help* *students understand:*
*Correct stream and course selection*
*College & branch prediction*
*Entrance exam strategy &* *preparation planning*
*Career options after 10th & 12th Science*
Alternative career paths beyond MBBS & Engineering
I believe every student is unique. My counseling approach is student-centric, practical, and result-oriented, focusing on reducing confusion, exam fear, and wrong career decisions.
 Key Strengths
Expert guidance for JEE, MHT-CET & NEET
Clear roadmap from school to professional career
Parent–student counseling support
Updated knowledge of cut-offs, colleges & trends
Motivation + discipline-based mentoring
# Vision
To help students make confident, informed, and future-ready career decisions and build a strong foundation for academic and professional success.

*Our Tie Up with*
1) K.K Wagh Institute Of Engineering Education and Research

2) Guru Gobind Singh College Of Engineering And Research Centre, Nashik Nashik, Maharashtra

3) sandip foundation engineering college nashik
